registration: After the first molecular seed's guard scores and incomplete v29 proposal trajectories were observed, before this replay decomposition. No running training source or selection rule changes.
question: Do old rules lose value when the shared policy and calibration change, or do newly accepted edits fail to transfer from fresh witnesses to proposal patients?
data: Existing proposal patients only. Read saved immutable round policies, thresholds and actual edit logs. Do not use test patients or generate new rules/model requests.
decomposition: For each own-error-agent round, evaluate the current calibrated policy alone, the prior round's retained memory on this current policy, and the current round's retained memory on this same policy. Carryover effect equals prior-memory minus no-memory; current-edit effect equals current-memory minus prior-memory. Also replay each actual candidate edit in its logged sequence on proposal patients, including rejected edits, without changing the original state transition.
endpoints: Patient-average F1/Jaccard differences, actual accepted/rejected decisions, affected patients and visit fixes/regressions. Compare each logged fresh-witness effect with its proposal effect. This is descriptive development attribution, not a new optimized agent or confirmation of a causal learning trajectory.
publication_gate: Publish only seeds with completed independent v29 model/program/output audits. Preserve original training decisions and metrics. No repair is selected or promoted by this diagnostic.
